name: Boltic Airfield
groundLayout: IBLT is a single-runway airfield (Runway 1/19) with no separate taxiway system - the Apron and FBO sit directly alongside the runway near the Runway 19 end, and aircraft taxi on the runway itself to reach them. There's a Backtrack Area near the Runway 1 end for turning around after landing/before departure. No taxiway letters exist here - never invent one.
